notes.title: New Game: Tales of Tuscany
notes.content:
Hello Rhapsodogs! I'm extremely excited to announce that I've just revealed a brand new RPG that takes place in the world of Athenian Rhapsody, called Tales of Tuscany. Please wishlist the game right here, then come back and read the rest!

Tales of Tuscany is not a direct sequel, but still carries over lots of lore, characters, and elements you loved from Athenian Rhapsody in a new, updated format. I tried my best to accelerate everything you loved in AR and also improve upon the game's shortcomings, and the best way to do this was to rip up and rework the engine a bit! Improvements include...

 An infinite inventory seperated by categories (Weapons, Armor, Food, Stuff)
 A faster protagonist + an ACTION button that lets you destroy the world around you and interact with objects/characters in new ways
 The ability to add nearly every opponent to your party, with more BURST skills that are balanced/defensive so that no follower is useless in a pacifist run
 A more in-depth RPG system, and battles that aren't based on reaching a turn-limit
 More creative and well-programmed REACT minigames, minigames out of battle, and QOL options
 Character customization and your very own Village where you will progressively unlock interactions, customizations, cool buffs, and more!
 Shiny hunting


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40954853/9ea853dca1cbfa831adcc220d5ba71d97e134356.gif

I hope you are as excited to see this as I am to reveal it - please wishlist it, and stay tuned for what comes next!

notes.title: Plush Launch + New DLC Event
notes.content:
Rhapsodogs, you're in for a MAJOR treat!!!

What's New:
- The Goober's Picnic Event has now left the rotation, and in its stead - Uncle Billiard's Barbecue becomes available!
- Thunder Goober 35cm Plush (with buttcheeks) are FINALLY available on my online shop!!! Get your own at athenianrhapsody.com

About the Uncle Billiard's Barbecue Event
Join Thunder Goober as you sail away to a rural land, where you'll be able to assemble your very own burgers alongside Uncle Billiard. This Event includes new Rhapsody customizations, a great quest and a lot of fun interactions, and several armors - one of them is even an armor + weapon combo (the first one of its kind in Athenian Rhapsody).

This is the biggest Event dropped thus far - I can't wait to see what burgers you make, and how you like the Uncle Billiard fight!!! This is one of the latest animations/battles I've made using the ARhap engine, so I hope its quality reflects that.

About the PLUSH + Rhapsody Discount
Many of you have been harassing me about this for months... and finally, you can get your own! The 35cm plush looks amazing, has buttcheeks, and ships internationally!

I designed this plush myself, worked closely with manufacturers to perfect its design, organized shipping, everything on my own - this was a huge pain in the butt, but I finally have massive boxes of thunder goobers in my basement just waiting to be mailed out!

When picking up a plush, enjoy 20% off of all and any Rhapsodies included in your order, too! Thanks so much.

I have many, MANY things going on behind the scenes for Athenian Rhapsody right now... I'll have some great announcements for you coming in the new years - but for now, I'm just hustling on it!

notes.title: Athenian Rhapsody Artbook + Manual Release!!!
notes.content:
Rhapsodogs - I have something REALLY cool to share with you...

I'm releasing an Athenian Rhapsody Manual and an Athenian Rhapsody Artbook!!! Both of these books have a huge amount of content, both for new and veteran players. I've made both of these booklets myself, and I really hope that you, the Rhapsodogs, enjoy discovering what's inside.

Both are available for purchase as a bundle as a DLC for Athenian Rhapsody on the main game page, here are some additional details...

The Manual:
Inside of the manual is a guide towards the game's mechanics, hints towards side quests, tips, tricks, and some general information about Athens and its lore. Discover "Rhapsofacts" which will not only help you with your gameplay, but also enrich your real-life smarts.

The Artbook:
As many of you may or may not know, I actually have a background in traditional drawing, specifically transformational anatomy which I studied before becoming a game developer. In this booklet, I go over the process behind my character creation, how I animate my sprites, why many, many decisions were made artistically and even a bunch of beta renditions of character designs.

If you're interested in Athenian Rhapsody, Game Development, or even Classic/Vintage Video Game Manuals/Materials, this is definitely for you!

Once again, I appreciate all of the love and support I have received for this game from you as a community - I consider myself one of the luckiest people alive because I have the ability to do what I love as a career. In 2025, I will have some amazing things to show you!!!

Also... Thunder Goober Plush are coming soon!

notes.title: New Event - Goober's Picnic is Live!!!!
notes.content:
There's a NEW EVENT LIVE NOW in Athenian Rhapsody!!!

Event Overview:
Goober's Picnic is now activated and ready for you to receive and play during your Rhapsodies! This Event is a small one, which allows the player to visit somewhere in Athens closest to Elysium... Here, you and Thunder Goober will share some tea while he almost completely pulls back the curtain on how this "Rhapsody System" really started...

This Event gives ALL players of all devices access to the exclusive TGPD armors, early access to the portable camera, and unifies a lot of lore that you may have pieced together or were hoping to learn. It ALSO has a funny effect that carries over in-game (not IBS)

How to receive Events:
In the main menu, head to the "Rhapsodies" menu and connect to the Online System. Once there, head to the menu where you'll find the online features such as your profile, recent trades, etc - there you will see the "Events" section where you can check for and receive this Event Rhapsody!

Once you have this Event, though it's available for download for a limited time, you will be able to play it forever.

Here is a skit I filmed for the launch of Goober's Picnic - please watch and enjoy!

A bug fixing update will be live soon alongside anything found in this round of bug testing for the event, this one includes much more content than the OTK one, new armors, a new weapon+armor combo, and a character many of you know and love but have never been able to experience in-game yet!

I also have a small event finished after this one which will give players access to items they previously may not have been able to if they did not have any TGPD tokens, as well as early access to the portable camera for some cool and fun silly little photos.

notes.title: Athenian Rhapsody's FIRST FREE DLC Crossover with OTK Games Expo!!!
notes.content:
Dogs. This is an epic moment in Athenian Rhapsody history!

In collaboration with the OTK Games Expo, Athenian Rhapsody unveils its first Event!!! Travel alongside Asmongold and friends to take on a new epic boss... Learn a little bit more about the world of Athens and its history - but for now, you may have more questions than answers after playing. Luckily, more events are planned and they will get bigger and bigger!!!

Thank you so much for the OTK team for making this possible - The developer of Athenian Rhapsody is also appearing in-person during the showcase, which you can find here below: 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5uTdsnqf29s

What's an Event?

Events in Athenian Rhapsody are a special form of DLC which allows players to access new places midway in their story to discover new characters, equip new armors and gear, battle with new followers, and deck out their Rhapsodies with exclusive accolades.

How do I access Events in Athenian Rhapsody?

To access an Event Rhapsody, all you have to do is connect to the online system and select the option to check for Events. You will obtain a special type of Rhapsody when an Event is active! This Event will run for the entirety of June, so anytime you log in this month you can obtain it - get it before it's gone! Once you have the Event Rhapsody, you will always be able to access the content it unlocks.

If you have an Event Rhapsody in your collection, you may access it by speaking to Thu- I mean Captain Goober in Primo, on his sick motorboat.

Thanks for reading! I hope you enjoy this little bit of extra content delivered in a cool, unique way that I hope is special to you guys. If it seems like you like the content of this one and the system, I'm going to create larger and bigger add-ons to this game and even introduce new types of Rhapsodies for you to stack with your existing ones and obtain. This is the first step into something that could be amazing!

Hey, one more thing!

If you have any difficulty with receiving the event, worry not as we have plenty of time to solve any issues so that everyone can receive it. This is super ambitious for my team and I, and we would appreciate all of the help and feedback we can get!

With this event being our first, we hope to refine the system so that we can do more and more in the future. Thank you!

notes.title: Athenian Rhapsody Gameplay Trailer
notes.content:
Not familiar with ATHENIAN RHAPSODY, or hungry for more information about the game? Well no sweat, we've got a new gameplay focused trailer that hopes to explain more about this mysterious allergy torture chamber/souls-like platonic dating sim/intense WarioWare-like emotional journey! Buckle up!

[previewyoutube=ugMZx-3pjrQ;full][/previewyoutube]
So what's this game about, anyways?
Welcome to the world of Athens, where you'll jump feet first into crafting your own epic RPG story! Athenian Rhapsody is a game where players are free to make their own decisions about how to handle any situation, altercation, and shenanigan which they face.

The premise of Athenian Rhapsody is to let players explore, learn, and build relationships as they please in an imaginary world full of excitement, humor, and secrets to uncover. The world responds to how your player runs through it - and there is no "right" way to play! Follow your heart and create your own special Rhapsody.

Choose to DEFEAT or BEFRIEND each enemy you come across - either collect their EXP and grow stronger, or add another friend to your social circle. Who knows what making different decisions could lead to? Your decisions will allow your story to unfold in ways you may not initially expect...

This game has so many options to choose throughout the story that no two players will ever have the same story. After you finish a completely unique and special playthrough, you'll receive a postcard which contains all of the information from your epic called a Rhapsody.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40954853/8f739c47c609b4a0210d1f375c0fa4c52d33864c.png
So you've just completed a long playthrough full of immense challenges, time spent with your favorite party members, and amazing pieces of lore you managed to dig up. Heck, let's say you've gotten THREE of these babies! What can you do with 'em now?

Trade Rhapsodies across any devices you wish - Whether you're taking Athenian Rhapsody on the go or sitting at your favorite LED ridden setup, you can trade Rhapsodies with anyone anywhere. That means trade entire playthroughs as collectibles, even if it's only temporarily to learn about each other's experiences!

Narrate Rhapsodies - Crack open that Rhap and receive a full list of the protagonist's stats, personality, and adventures in Athens! Do this to compare stats like who had more game overs, who had the most money stolen from their protagonist, badges awarded to various party members, and more nitty gritty details like your favorite foods!

Stack Rhapsodies - What's cooler than one Rhapsody? Two Rhapsodies meshed together! Maybe even THREE Rhapsodies! You get a Rhapsody, and YOU get a Rhapsody, and- sorry, let's get back on track.

Combine Rhapsodies of different pathways to create a Stacked Rhapsody - in this epic artifact, both or all three playthroughs will be compared and contrasted, hidden details and information about the epic tales will be revealed, and a deeper understand of who you really are will shine through!

Delete your friend's Rhapsodies - don't do this


So this is Athenian Rhapsody. To be honest, it's YOUR Athenian Rhapsody.

This world aims to be a fun, lighthearted, and adventurous escape for you, whoever you are - and aims to invigorate each and every player's passion and energy for living the life they deserve! Remember who you are, how your uniqueness makes you special, how much you have to be grateful for, and keep each reminder with you forever in your Rhapsodies.

notes.title: PAX East 2024 + Release Date Following
notes.content:
Athenian Rhapsody is attending PAX East 2024 with a RELEASE DATE following shortly!

Athenian Rhapsody at PAX:
Like stated in the title, Athenian Rhapsody will be at PAX East 2024 showcasing an exclusive in-person demo featuring the character Uncle Billiard. This demo is only available to convention goers at the moment, and has been designed to be a more immersive and quick experience for the player.

We've also ordered several thousand Thunder Goober hats for attendees to wear around the convention and cosplay everyone's favorite wizard (irritable bowel syndrome sold separately). PAX East is the only place you'll be able to obtain these hats at the moment, and they're made of very sturdy material too so they'll definitely serve as a long lasting pre-launch souvenir.

I also plan to do daily giveaways of Athenian Rhapsody through digitally redeemable codes which will be sent to winners upon the release of the game - I'm not sure of the exact details yet, but during the show day submissions will be collected and winners will be announced at the end of each day.

Release Date Announcement:
We're just about ready to start our full rollout of Athenian Rhapsody and announce our planned release date to the public - this will most likely be ready within several weeks of PAX East through a brand new trailer. This will be extremely exciting as we have lots of collaborations, content, and exciting things planned for the rollout.

Please stay alert with open eyes and ears after PAX so that you don't miss any new exciting pieces of news from Athenian Rhapsody in regards to release!

notes.title: Tokyo Game Show 2022 - And A New Demo!
notes.content:
Athenian Rhapsody has the awesome privilege of being shown off at Tokyo Game Show 2022, alongside the release of an updated demo! A lot of work has went into this event for the past month, and my team and I are extremely excited to finally share it with you. Thank you to you guys for creating an amazing community around Athenian Rhapsody and supporting it for the past year.

The updated demo is the same snipbit of content as the prior one, except with one full year of updates under its belt. In this demo, you'll be able to experience:

 Activation of New Routes
 A New Secret Boss
 Heavily Updated Gameplay
 The Final Title Screen
 Generally a better experience with Athenian Rhapsody, and more representative of how the final game will look and feel.
 [strike]All instances of Cattail have been removed from the game.[/strike]

I'm so excited for you all to play it that I am genuinely freaking out, whether it's your first or third time playing through the demo there's something new for you to look forward to. There are some real challenges, and a few suspicious events that you may discover along your path...

Discuss your experience, and follow ARhap's other social medias here on my linktree!
